# ex: implicit op cancellation with parenthesized inner expressions (ex.go:601-606, 615-620)
# Part 1: op=='*' (pattern T, source *T via (&x)), replx is ParenExpr(&x).
# The inner & in parens cancels the implicit *.
# Part 2: op=='&' (pattern *T, source T via (*ptr)), replx is ParenExpr(*ptr).
# The inner * in parens cancels the implicit &.
ex {
	var t T
	t.Val() -> Use(t)
}
ex {
	var p *T
	p.M() -> UseP(p)
}
-- x.go --
package p

type T struct{ v int }

func (t T) Val() int { return t.v }
func (t *T) M() int  { return t.v }

func Use(t T) int    { return t.v }
func UseP(t *T) int  { return t.v }

func f() {
	var x T
	_ = (&x).Val()

	var ptr *T
	_ = (*ptr).M()
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -5,13 +5,13 @@
 func (t T) Val() int { return t.v }
 func (t *T) M() int  { return t.v }

-func Use(t T) int    { return t.v }
-func UseP(t *T) int  { return t.v }
+func Use(t T) int   { return t.v }
+func UseP(t *T) int { return t.v }

 func f() {
 	var x T
-	_ = (&x).Val()
+	_ = Use(x)

 	var ptr *T
-	_ = (*ptr).M()
+	_ = UseP(ptr)
 }
